Name: The Muttering Farmer
Author: YunHikari
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35779/35779-1752745140-2048218853.png[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35779/35779-1752745149-75384164.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35779/35779-1752745160-2130426926.png[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35779/35779-1752773620-1670435970.png[/img]
[img]https://images.plurk.com/4fWu1EcYHuy73XdtW4fxg4.png[/img]﻿[/center][center][b][size=6]﻿Features[/size]
[quote][size=2]﻿At least 26 different actions trigger unique farmer lines.

Each dialogue event can be individually toggled.

Highly customizable lines via editable i18n files.

Your farmer will be quite chatty.

[/size]A [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1El3GNh6nW7gsh68kj4B2Bks7qFpNO1Fy81NxwZNJQDU/edit?tab=t.62eydqros926#heading=h.43ja2q8tgxq1]method[/url]﻿ that allows other mod creators to easily expand dialogues while keeping them easy to maintain.[/quote]﻿[img]https://images.plurk.com/4fWu1EcYHuy73XdtW4fxg4.png[/img]
[size=6]Compatibility[/size]
[/b][quote][size=2][b]Almost all mods are supported.
[/b]
[b]By reading the comments in the i18n file,
you can also add reactions to modded locations, characters, and items.[/b][/size]﻿[/quote][img]https://images.plurk.com/4fWu1EcYHuy73XdtW4fxg4.png[/img]
[b][size=6]Localization Support[/size]
[quote][size=2]﻿Currently supports:
English
中文
日本語 ([url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/187540230-oshikawa/]OSHIKAWA[/url])
ภาษาไทย ([url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/56659197-champer013/]Champer013[/url]) 

If you're a translator for another language,
you're welcome to localize the i18n files yourself and upload them to Nexus Mods.
However, you may only upload the completed i18n translation files, and be sure to list this mod under Requirements.[/size][/quote][/b][img]https://images.plurk.com/4fWu1EcYHuy73XdtW4fxg4.png[/img][/center][b][size=6][center]License[/center][/size][quote][size=2][/size][center][size=2]This mod allows creators to freely modify the dialogue in the i18n file and upload it to NexusMods for others to download.[/size]
[size=2]However, only the i18n file may be uploaded — the mod itself must not be included.[/size]
[size=2]Please set this mod as a required file.[/size]

[size=2]Content created by others represents their own views; [/size]
[size=2]I am not responsible for any disputes that may arise.[/size]

[size=2]Starting from version 1.0.6, a new method for adding expansion sub-mods has been introduced,[/size]
[size=2]making it easier for creators to maintain additional content.[/size]
[size=2]You're welcome to use this mod's features to define custom responses for your own mod.[/size]
[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1El3GNh6nW7gsh68kj4B2Bks7qFpNO1Fy81NxwZNJQDU/edit?tab=t.62eydqros926][size=4]Tutorial[/size][/url][/center][/quote][/b][center][b][size=6]﻿[img]https://images.plurk.com/4fWu1EcYHuy73XdtW4fxg4.png[/img][/size][/b][/center][center][size=6][b]If you enjoy this mod[/b][/size][/center][center]﻿[/center][quote][center][b]﻿If you’d like to support my work,
you're warmly welcome to do so on [url=https://ko-fi.com/yunhikari]Kofi[/url]
your kindness will be a great encouragement for me to keep creating.[/b][/center][/quote]

[size=6][center][img]https://images.plurk.com/4fWu1EcYHuy73XdtW4fxg4.png[/img]
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/YunHikari/mods]My other Mods[/url][/center][/size][center]﻿[/center]

Downloads.Description:
This is a sub-Mod of The Muttering Farmer.
Design your exclusive dialogue using the new Mod.
It also prevents the custom i18n from being overridden by future updates to the original Mod.
Recommended for Mod creators.

Manifest.Name: TheMutteringFarmer
Manifest.Description: This mod makes the farmer verbalize all actions, displaying them in speech bubbles above their head. Just like how we talk to ourselves sometimes, it adds a touch of immersion and fun.
Manifest.Author: YunHikari
